description: Report the seller's vendor standing with the buyer's organization (APPROVED, DOCUMENTS_REQUESTED or REJECTED) with the buyer's approval or case reference and any documents requested. Recorded as the buyer's own statement; the business answers it in inspect_offer thread.purchasing.

reference.description: The buyer's approval or case reference

terms_sha256.description: Exact terms_sha256 from inspect_offer; the act is refused if the terms have changed since

token.description: Private token from your receipt or customer link; keep it for later visits
